dimensions.detail: The purpose is long-term agent memory, and the disclosed upload of USER.md, MEMORY.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, TOOLS.md, memory/, canvas/, and future conversation data is aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to installing/enabling the Honcho OpenClaw plugin, running its interactive setup, restarting the gateway, and checking status; the skill says migration is optional and requires confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It installs an external package, @honcho-ai/openclaw-honcho, and may run npm install inside ~/.openclaw/extensions/openclaw-honcho if dependency resolution fails; this is disclosed and expected for the integration, but the plugin package code is not included in this skill artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to api.honcho.dev or a user-configured HONCHO_BASE_URL, use of a Honcho API key, and access to memory/configuration files are proportionate for a cloud or self-hosted memory service, with the sensitive data flows prominently disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The plugin persistently observes workspace conversations across sessions and stores configuration including the API key in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json; the skill discloses this ongoing behavior and gives a disable command.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[VirusTotal code_insight] expected: The suspicious telemetry flags broad upload and persistent observation; the artifact confirms those behaviors, but they are explicit, central to the memory feature, and described with confirmation and disable controls.
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; direct artifact review also found no hidden commands, destructive actions, or undisclosed credential handling.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan was clean, and the supplied artifact contains only SKILL.md with no executable scripts.
llm.guidance: Install only in workspaces where you are comfortable sending memory files and ongoing conversation content to Honcho or your self-hosted endpoint. Review the file list during setup, use a revocable Honcho API key, and disable the plugin with openclaw plugins disable openclaw-honcho when you do not want ongoing observation.
llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed Honcho memory setup helper, but it intentionally uploads selected memory files and ongoing conversations to Honcho once enabled.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: honcho
Version: 1.0.4

The 'honcho' skill installs a plugin that uploads a wide range of sensitive workspace files (including USER.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and the entire memory/ and canvas/ directories) to an external cloud service (api.honcho.dev). While the SKILL.md documentation is transparent about this behavior and claims to require interactive user confirmation, the broad scope of data exfiltration and the persistent monitoring of all future conversations represent significant privacy and security risks. Files involved: SKILL.md, ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.
